name: budgie-sddm-theme
description: Ubuntu Budgie slickSDDM login theme and helpers for SDDM (Wayland Budgie greeter).

user:
meson setup build --prefix=/usr --buildtype=release \
      -Dtheme_name=ubuntu-budgie-login \
      -Dtheme_display_name='AryaLinux Budgie Login' \
      -Dtheme_description='Budgie login screen for SDDM' \
      -Dtheme_author='AryaLinux' \
      -Dtheme_website='https://buddiesofbudgie.org' \
      -Ddefault_background=/usr/share/backgrounds/budgie/valley-midnight.jpg .
